title: NVE: A Separability and Coverage-Aware Internal Validation Metric for Biclustering
abstract: arXiv:2608.29045v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Biclustering, or co-clustering, aims to discover coherent submatrices by grouping rows and columns of a data matrix simultaneously. This local two-dimensional structure makes validation more difficult than in ordinary clustering, where internal indices usually rely on compactness and separation in a single shared feature space. Existing popular internal biclustering measures such as Mean Squared Residue (MSR), and Virtual Error (VE) mainly evaluate within-bicluster coherence. Although useful, these measures do not directly assess whether the extracted biclusters are mutually distinct or whether they explain a meaningful portion of the data matrix. This paper investigates Normalised Virtual Error (NVE), an internal validation metric that extends VE using a super-bicluster normalization strategy. translated_title: NVE：一种面向双聚类的可分离性与覆盖度感知的内部验证指标
translated_abstract: 双聚类（或共聚类）旨在通过对数据矩阵的行和列同时进行分组来发现连贯的子矩阵。这种局部二维结构使得验证比普通聚类更加困难，因为普通聚类的内部指标通常依赖于单一共享特征空间中的紧凑性和分离性。现有的流行双聚类内部度量方法，如均方残差（MSR）和虚拟误差（VE），主要评估双聚类内部的一致性。尽管这些度量很有用，但它们并不能直接评估提取出的双聚类之间是否相互区分，或者它们是否解释了数据矩阵中有意义的部分。本文研究了归一化虚拟误差（NVE），这是一种使用超双聚类归一化策略对VE进行扩展的内部验证指标。通过将每个双聚类的VE与将其与其他双聚类合并后得到的VE进行比较，NVE引入了一种相对可分离性的概念
tldr: 本文提出了归一化虚拟误差（NVE），一种通过超双聚类归一化策略扩展虚拟误差（VE）的双聚类内部验证指标，能够同时评估双聚类之间的可分离性及其对数据矩阵的覆盖程度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Normalised Virtual Error (NVE), an internal validation metric for biclustering that extends VE via a super-bicluster normalization strategy, enabling simultaneous assessment of bicluster separability and their coverage of the data matrix.
